title: Память как у слона  (A Memory Like an Elephant)

segments.t: Still fuming over his phone call with Elena, Viktor Petrovich nods absently while the wedding organizer lists specific dishes for the banquet. When Vika notices he is not writing anything down, the Chef waves her off and boasts that as head chef he has a memory like an elephant.
Я же шеф, я все запомнил.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'Vitya, are you even listening?' Notice how Russian expresses 'beaten' and 'are listening to' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Yes, yes, of course.' The meaning hinges on 'yes' working together with 'yes' in spoken Russian.
'Are there any problems?' Notice how Russian expresses 'some kind of' and 'problems' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.
'No, no, please continue.' In Russian, the idea of 'there is no' flows naturally into 'continue' without extra filler words.
'What do we have next on the list?' In Russian, the idea of 'what' flows naturally into 'next' without extra filler words.
'We are keeping that. Turbot.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'to leave' before landing on 'blockhead'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Yes, I understood everything.' The meaning hinges on 'yes' working together with 'understood?' in spoken Russian.
Я же шеф, я все запомнил.
'I am the head chef, I memorized all of it.' Kostya anchors the line on 'I', while 'to remember' completes the thought.
'See you very soon.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'until' and 'ambulance' in a few short words. Kostya answers right away.
'Do not worry at all.' Notice how Russian expresses 'you' and 'worry' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'He will remember everything.' Notice how Russian expresses 'all' and 'will remember' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'He has a memory like that animal.' Kostya anchors the line on 'memory', while 'of this' completes the thought. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'A memory like an elephant.' In Russian, the idea of 'memory' flows naturally into 'an elephant' without extra filler words. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Я же шеф, я все запомнил.
When you watch Scene 8 of Episode 20, listen out for the exchange around a memory like an elephant — you will recognize every Russian phrase right away. See you in the next scene.
